input.question: Why is China buying so many companies around the world?
input.ground_truth: The Chinese government is not buying 'so many' companies around the world. Rich Chinese people are buying companies around the world for the same reason rich people of any nation do - because it's a great way to make even more money, and to diversify your wealth.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why is China buying so many companies around the world?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you really, really like toy cars. You already have lots of toy cars at home, but you hear that there’s a company that makes the best toy cars in the whole world. So, you decide to buy that company so you can have all their toy cars and make even more.

China is kind of like that, but instead of toy cars, they want to have lots of different kinds of companies in other countries. They think that by buying these companies, they can make more things, learn new ways to do things, and become even stronger in the world. It’s like collecting the best helpers to make lots of cool stuff together!
